OBJECTIVE1A: Foley is being held in a small building, north-east of the bridge. Secure the position, then rescue Foley.
M01_BRF_TXT: Paul 'Eagle-eye' Foley, one of our best snipers, was captured while trying to destroy one of the bridges along the Kuwait-Iraq border. This bridge must be destroyed to slow down the Iraqi advance.  We can't spare enough men for a full-scale assault, but one man should be able to penetrate the defenses, locate and rescue Foley, then destroy the bridge. Once the mission has been completed, return to the LZ for helicopter extraction.
OBJECTIVE3A: Use the C4 to destroy the upper central struts of the bridge.
SPEECH1: Get that C4 rigged, quick. If they see us we're dead.
SPEECH2: I'm on it, just another few seconds.
SPEECH5: Alpha-Two, this is Voodoo-Three. Foley's last communication placed him north of the bridge.
SPEECH6: Roger that Voodoo-3. See you later. Over.
SPEECH7: Good to see you. What kept you?
OBJECTIVE1C: Intelligence indicates that the best approach is along this dry riverbed.
OBJECTIVE1D: This border checkpoint is heavily guarded and should be avoided.
SECTIONTEXT: On July 24, 1990 Iraqi forces began massing on the Kuwait border. As negotiations broke down, United Nations Special Forces teams were dispatched to the Middle East. On August 2, Iraq invaded Kuwait. As the Iraqi tanks crossed the border the Special Forces moved into action.

HELPTXT_3: Return to the LZ. Press objectives (%s) for more information.
OBJECTIVE_4A: Return to the landing zone with Foley for helicopter extraction.
SPEECH5A: Rescue Foley, blow the bridge and return for extraction. Good Luck. Over.
